sources.author: Nomad
sources.title: Token Bridge: Architecture
sources.finding: A Replica processes and dispatches a message to the BridgeRouter; the BridgeRouter sends escrowed native tokens or mints representations to the recipient.
sources.interpretation: The fixed Replica does not define the asset-custody boundary; zero Replica outflow is architecturally expected, and retained source values confirm it.

sources.author: Nomad
sources.title: Nomad Bridge Hack: Root Cause Analysis
sources.finding: The Replica authentication failure admitted fraudulent messages to the Nomad BridgeRouter.

sources.author: Nomad
sources.title: The Road to Recovery
sources.finding: The team links its open dataset of addresses and transactions involved in the exploit, and separately discusses whitehat returns.

sources.author: Nomad
sources.title: Nomad Hack Data
sources.finding: The published hash list has 960 unique entries; it is used as documentary membership after frozen V7 scoring, not as a complete malicious-execution ground truth.
